description: This file contains unit tests for the 'RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector' class in the Orleans runtime project's placement filter component. It verifies behaviors such as creation, filtering logic with matching and non-matching metadata, and filtering multiple silos.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirectorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for the RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector, containing various test cases.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_CanBeCreated
methods.description: Test to check if the filter director can be instantiated successfully.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_CanBeCalled
methods.description: Test to verify the filter method of the director returns a non-null, non-empty list when called.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToNothingWhenNoEntry
methods.description: Test that filtering yields no results when the silo does not have the relevant metadata entry.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToNothingWhenDifferentValue
methods.description: Test that filtering yields no results when the metadata value does not match.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToSiloWhenMatching
methods.description: Test that filtering includes the silo when metadata matches.

methods.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterDirector_FiltersToMultipleSilosWhenMatching
methods.description: Test that multiple silos with matching metadata are all included in the filtered result.
